matches.snippet: Tierlist of all HC + Evo Towers 9. Brawler. Decent for speedrunning. That's all. 8. Necromancer. matches.title: Why juggernaut is doodoo DPS slop
matches.snippet: Why juggernaut is doodoo DPS slop No seriously, it used to look like a good choice but now it just looks so incredibly grindy when other, actually viable evos came around. Jugg is quite literally just good for it's "DPS", which you have to pay half a million just to even make it a reasonable choice. It's not a bad tower, but it's heavily outclassed by other evos like Kingpin and the recent Enforcer. Not only that, but the "10k DPS" claim is sheer exaggeration. no one, especially a solo player where it's most efficient will have many supports, but even if they do get all the specs somehow, your loadout is literally just Juggernaut and Friends. You should not complain about the game, or modes in general being boring or "bad" if your playstyle is being Elon musk for 20 waves and placing Jugg. I don't hate Jugg. verified_top_matches.snippet: Why juggernaut is doodoo DPS slop No seriously, it used to look like a good choice but now it just looks so incredibly grindy when other, actually viable evos came around. Jugg is quite literally just good for it's "DPS", which you have to pay half a million just to even make it a reasonable choice. It's not a bad tower, but it's heavily outclassed by other evos like Kingpin and the recent Enforcer. Not only that, but the "10k DPS" claim is sheer exaggeration. no one, especially a solo player where it's most efficient will have many supports, but even if they do get all the specs somehow, your loadout is literally just Juggernaut and Friends. You should not complain about the game, or modes in general being boring or "bad" if your playstyle is being Elon musk for 20 waves and placing Jugg. I don't hate Jugg. It's a good tower, but it's just incredibly brain-dead to use. saying your favourite tower is Jugg is the equivalent of saying "infinity + 1". Again, it's good for some hard modes like Voidcore. But I am not bringing jugg to play frost.
